24692-a-bit-of-sunshine.title: A Bit Of Sunshine
24692-a-bit-of-sunshine.creator: Unknown
24692-a-bit-of-sunshine.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In the boat it-self was a boy. He was lean-ing o-ver the side and look-ing down at his fa-ther. His hat had blown off, and he looked like such a nice boy that Kate smiled at him as they went by. He laughed back and made her a lit-tle bow, but the hors-es went by so fast that she saw him for a min-ute on-ly.

arxiv-2012-02639.title: Rethinking Movie Genre Classification with Fine Grained Semantic Clustering
arxiv-2012-02639.creator: Edward Fish University of Surrey edward.fish@surrey.ac.uk, Jon Weinbren University of Surrey j.weinbren@surrey.ac.uk, Andrew Gilbert University of Surrey a.gilbert@surrey.ac.uk
arxiv-2012-02639.description: Abstract Movie genre classification is an active research area in machine learning. However, due to the limited labels available, there can be large semantic variations between movies within a single genre definition. We expand these ‘coarse’ genre labels by identifying ‘fine-grained’ semantic information within the multi-modal content of movies.

arxiv-2109-12932.title: Sparse spatial transformers for few-shot learning
arxiv-2109-12932.creator: Haoxing CHEN, Huaxiong LI, Yaohui LI, Chunlin CHEN
arxiv-2109-12932.description: Abstract Learning from limited data is challenging because data scarcity leads to a poor generalization of the trained model. A classical global pooled representation will probably lose useful local information. Many few-shot learning methods have recently addressed this challenge using deep descriptors and learning a pixel-level metric. However, using deep descriptors as feature representations may lose image contextual information.

arxiv-2203-04224.title: Higgs bundles and SYZ geometry
arxiv-2203-04224.creator: Sebastian Heller, Charles Ouyang, Franz Pedit
arxiv-2203-04224.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sebastian Heller, Charles Ouyang, Franz Pedit. Using non-Abelian Hodge theory for parabolic Higgs bundles, we construct infinitely many non-congruent hyperbolic affine spheres modeled on a thrice-punctured sphere with monodromy in 𝐒𝐋 3 ​ ( ℤ ) {\bf SL}_{3}(\mathbb{Z}) . These give rise to non-isometric semi-flat Calabi–Yau metrics on special Lagrangian torus bundles over an open ball in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} with a Y-vertex deleted, thereby answering a question raised by Loftin, Yau, and Zaslow in [ 32 ] , [ 33 ] .

arxiv-2209-00983.title: The Effect of Robot Posture and Idle Motion on Spontaneous Emotional Contagion during Robot-Human Interactions
arxiv-2209-00983.creator: Isabel Casso, Bing Li, Tatjana Nazir, Yvonne N. Delevoye-Turrell
arxiv-2209-00983.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Isabel Casso, Bing Li, Tatjana Nazir, Yvonne N. Delevoye-Turrell. In the next decade, social robots will be implemented in many public spaces to provide services to humans. We question the properties of these social robots to afford acceptance and spontaneous emotional interactions. More specifically, in the present study, we report the effects of idle motion frequency in a robot on emotional contagion, in a face-to-face interactive task with a human participant.

arxiv-2305-18666.title: BiSLS/SPS: Auto-tune Step Sizes for Stable Bi-level Optimization
arxiv-2305-18666.creator: Chen Fan, Gaspard Choné-Ducasse, Mark Schmidt, Christos Thrampoulidis
arxiv-2305-18666.description: Abstract The popularity of bi-level optimization (BO) in deep learning has spurred a growing interest in studying gradient-based BO algorithms. However, existing algorithms involve two coupled learning rates that can be affected by approximation errors when computing hypergradients, making careful fine-tuning necessary to ensure fast convergence.

arxiv-2312-13076.title: How to Integrate Digital Twin and Virtual Reality in Robotics Systems? Design and Implementation for Providing Robotics Maintenance Services in Data Centers
arxiv-2312-13076.creator: Lin Xie, Hanyi Li
arxiv-2312-13076.description: Abstract In the context of Industry 4.0, the physical and digital worlds are closely connected, and robots are widely used to achieve system automation. Digital twin solutions have contributed significantly to the growth of Industry 4.0. Combining various technologies is a trend that aims to improve system performance.

arxiv-2407-09377.title: An alternative approach to the discrete Shnirelman’s inequality
arxiv-2407-09377.creator: Martina Zizza
arxiv-2407-09377.description: Abstract In this paper we examine the discrete Shnirelman’s inequality [ 8 ] , which relates the L 2 L^{2} -distance of two discrete configurations of a fluid to the L t 1 ​ L x 2 L^{1}_{t}L^{2}_{x} -norm of the vector field connecting them.

arxiv-2407-16049.title: The optimisation of short-term scheduling of science observations at Paranal observatory (VLT and ELT)
arxiv-2407-16049.creator: Joseph P. Anderson, Elyar Sedaghati, Aleksandar Cikota, Natalie Behara, Fuyan Bian, Angel Otarola, Steffen Mieske
arxiv-2407-16049.description: Abstract The efficiency of science observation Short-Term Scheduling (STS) can be defined as being a function of how many highly ranked observations are completed per unit time. Current STS at ESO’s Paranal observatory is achieved through filtering and ranking observations via well-defined algorithms, leading to a proposed observation at time t.

arxiv-2410-10803.title: Generalizable Humanoid Manipulation with 3D Diffusion Policies
arxiv-2410-10803.creator: Yanjie Ze, Zixuan Chen, Wenhao Wang, Tianyi Chen, Xialin He, Ying Yuan, Xue Bin Peng, Jiajun Wu
arxiv-2410-10803.description: Abstract Humanoid robots capable of autonomous operation in diverse environments have long been a goal for roboticists. However, autonomous manipulation by humanoid robots has largely been restricted to one specific scene, primarily due to the difficulty of acquiring generalizable skills and the expensiveness of in-the-wild humanoid robot data.

arxiv-2503-18244.title: CustomKD: Customizing Large Vision Foundation for Edge Model Improvement via Knowledge Distillation
arxiv-2503-18244.creator: Jungsoo Lee Debasmit Das Munawar Hayat, Sungha Choi Kyuwoong Hwang Fatih Porikli, Qualcomm AI Research {jungsool, debadas, hayat, sunghac, kyuwoong, fporikli}@qti.qualcomm.com
arxiv-2503-18244.description: Abstract We propose a novel knowledge distillation approach, CustomKD, that effectively leverages large vision foundation models (LVFMs) to enhance the performance of edge models ( e.g . , MobileNetV3). Despite recent advancements in LVFMs, such as DINOv2 and CLIP, their potential in knowledge distillation for enhancing edge models remains underexplored.

arxiv-2510-11654.title: FinVet: A Collaborative Framework of RAG and External Fact-Checking Agents for Financial Misinformation Detection
arxiv-2510-11654.creator: Daniel Berhane Araya, Duoduo Liao
arxiv-2510-11654.description: Abstract Financial markets face growing threats from misinformation that can trigger billions in losses in minutes. Most existing approaches lack transparency in their decision-making and provide limited attribution to credible sources. We introduce FinVet, a novel multi-agent framework that integrates two Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines with external fact-checking through a confidence-weighted voting mechanism.

arxiv-2511-13323.title: Discrete H H -theorem for a finite volume discretization of a nonlinear kinetic system: application to hypocoercivity
arxiv-2511-13323.creator: Marianne Bessemoulin-Chatard, Tino Laidin, Thomas Rey
arxiv-2511-13323.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Marianne Bessemoulin-Chatard, Tino Laidin, Thomas Rey. In this article, we study the long-time behavior of a finite-volume discretization for a nonlinear kinetic reaction model involving two interacting species. Building upon the seminal work of [Favre, Pirner, Schmeiser, ARMA, 2023], we extend the discrete exponential convergence to equilibrium result established in [Bessemoulin-Chatard, Laidin, Rey, IMAJNA, 2025], which was obtained in a perturbative framework using weighted L 2 L^{2} estimates.

arxiv-2512-15717.title: Strategic Bid Shading in Real-Time Bidding Auctions in Ad Exchange Using Minority Game Theory
arxiv-2512-15717.creator: Dipankar Das
arxiv-2512-15717.description: Abstract Traditional auction theory posits that bid value exhibits a positive correlation with the probability of securing the auctioned object in ascending auctions. However, under uncertainty and incomplete information, as is characteristic in real-time advertising markets, truthful bidding may not always represent a dominant strategy or yield a Pure Strategy Nash Equilibrium.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-gabriello-chi.creator: Joseph Dunn
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-gabriello-chi.description: Article 'Gabriello Chiabrera' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

europmc-pmc7185114.title: Does comorbidity increase the risk of patients with COVID-19: evidence from meta-analysis.
europmc-pmc7185114.creator: Wang B, Li R, Lu Z, Huang Y.
europmc-pmc7185114.description: Currently, the number of patients with coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) has increased rapidly, but relationship between comorbidity and patients with COVID-19 still not clear. The aim was to explore whether the presence of common comorbidities increases COVID-19 patients'...

pmc-10597266.title: Auctions Versus Fixed Prices: Lessons from a Procurement Pilot
pmc-10597266.creator: S Kuhmonen
pmc-10597266.description: ObjectivesPrivate health care providers are often acquired through procurement auctions to produce publicly financed services. In this study, we examine the costs and benefits of auctions compared to fixed price procurements. We analyze a procurement pilot that was conducted by Kela, the largest rehabilitation organizer in Finland.

pmc-11282017.title: Development of an initial training and evaluation programme for manual lower limb muscle MRI segmentation
pmc-11282017.creator: Jasper M. Morrow, Sachit Shah, Lara Cristiano, Matthew R. B. Evans, Carolynne M. Doherty, Talal Alnaemi, Abeer Saab, Ahmed Emira, Uros Klickovic, Ahmed Hammam, Afnan Altuwaijri, Stephen Wastling, Mary M. Reilly, Michael G. Hanna, Tarek A. Yousry, John S. Thornton
pmc-11282017.description: BackgroundMagnetic resonance imaging (MRI) quantification of intramuscular fat accumulation is a responsive biomarker in neuromuscular diseases. Despite emergence of automated methods, manual muscle segmentation remains an essential foundation. We aimed to develop a training programme for new observers to demonstrate competence in lower limb muscle segmentation and establish reliability benchmarks for future human observers and machine learning segmentation packages.

pmc-11335863.title: Identification and mapping of groundwater recharge zones using multi influencing factor and analytical hierarchy process
pmc-11335863.creator: Fanxiao Meng, Muhammad Ismail Khan, Syed Ali Asad Naqvi, Abid Sarwar, Fakhrul Islam, Muhammad Ali, Aqil Tariq, Sajid Ullah, Walid Soufan, Turki Kh. Faraj
pmc-11335863.description: The management of groundwater systems is essential for nations that rely on groundwater as the principal source of communal water supply (e.g., Mohmand District of Pakistan). The work employed Remote Sensing and GIS datasets to ascertain the groundwater recharge zones (GWRZ) in the Mohmand District of Pakistan.

pmc-11432896.title: Contrast enhanced longitudinal changes observed in an experimental bleomycin-induced lung fibrosis rat model by radial DCE-MRI at 9.4T
pmc-11432896.creator: René in ‘t Zandt, Irma Mahmutovic Persson, Marta Tibiletti, Karin von Wachenfeldt, Geoff J. M. Parker, Lars E. Olsson, on behalf of the TRISTAN Consortium, Francesca Pennati, Minghua Wu, Minghua Wu
pmc-11432896.description: Identifying biomarkers in fibrotic lung disease is key for early anti-fibrotic intervention. Dynamic contrast-enhanced (DCE) MRI offers valuable perfusion-related insights in fibrosis but adapting human MRI methods to rodents poses challenges. Here, we explored these translational challenges for the inflammatory and fibrotic phase of a bleomycin lung injury model in rats.

pmc-11453332.title: 7550 Case report on Concurrent Metastases to the Pituitary and Adrenal from a Primary Breast Cancer
pmc-11453332.creator: M V David-Santos, M C Isidro
pmc-11453332.description: Disclosure: M.V. David-santos: None. M.C. Isidro: None. Background: Metastatic Cancer to the pituitary gland is a rare condition accounting for 0.5% of all pituitary tumors. It rarely manifests clinically and is often found incidentally. Endocrine dysfunction usually arise, with 38.4% of cases presenting with Diabetes Insipidus, while 37.7% as Panhypopituitarism.

pmc-11546203.title: Epigenetic Mechanisms Induced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis to Promote Its Survival in the Host
pmc-11546203.creator: Shwetha Susan Thomas, Kuniyil Abhinand, Arjun M Menon, Bipin G Nair, Geetha B Kumar, K B Arun, Lekshmi K Edison, Aravind Madhavan, Andreas Burkovski
pmc-11546203.description: Tuberculosis caused by the obligate intracellular pathogen, Mycobacterium tuberculosis, is one among the prime causes of death worldwide. An urgent remedy against tuberculosis is of paramount importance in the current scenario. However, the complex nature of this appalling disease contributes to the limitations of existing medications.

pmc-11585848.title: An immunohistochemical study on the evaluation of mast cell, interleukin 17 and interleukin 1β profile in contagious caprine pleuropneumonia
pmc-11585848.creator: Ozhan Karatas, Gokhan Akcakavak
pmc-11585848.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Contagious caprine pleuropneumonia (CCPP) in goats is defined as a highly contagious and rapidly spreading mycoplasmal disease that is now among the leading causes of major economic losses on many continents (Asia, Africa and the Middle East). In this study, we aimed to evaluate immunohistochemically mast cells (MCs) profile and local interleukin (IL)-17 and IL-1β protein expressions in naturally infected CCPP according to the course of the inflammation (peracute-acute, subacute-chronic).

pmc-11606729.title: Live Fast, Die Young: Life History Traits of an Apex Predator Exacerbate the Ecological Impact of a Toxic Invader
pmc-11606729.creator: Georgia Ward‐Fear, Gregory P Brown, Lachlan Pettit, Lee‐Ann Rollins, Richard Shine
pmc-11606729.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). We studied a population of large varanid lizards (yellow‐spotted monitors Varanus panoptes ) on a floodplain in tropical Australia. Growth records from radio‐tracked lizards show that despite their large adult body sizes (to > 7 kg in males), these lizards attained sexual maturity at less than 1 year of age and rarely lived for more than 2 years (females) or 4 years (males), even before mortality increased due to the arrival of toxic cane toads ( Rhinella marina ).

pmc-12395718.title: Cognitive disability among older adults in Botswana: prevalence, trends, and sociodemographic determinants from cross-sectional data
pmc-12395718.creator: Tiro Theodore Monamo, Mpho Keetile, Gobopamang Letamo
pmc-12395718.description: BackgroundCognitive impairment is a critical issue among older adults, especially as populations age and demands on healthcare systems increase. In Botswana, the growing older adult population and the rising chronic diseases prevalence highlight the need for focused research on cognitive disability trends and their socio-demographic influences.

pmc-12428324.title: Effects of Methotrexate and Tofacitinib on Mitochondrial Function and Oxidative Stress in Human Synovial Cells In Vitro
pmc-12428324.creator: Valentina Mihaylova, Desislav Tomov, Rositsa Karalilova, Zguro Batalov, Anastas Batalov, Victoria Sarafian, Maria Kazakova
pmc-12428324.description: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is an autoimmune disease affecting the synovium. Mitochondrial dysfunction is considered a critical factor in the pathogenesis of RA. The aim of the study was to determine the effect of methotrexate and tofacitinib on mitochondrial function and oxidative stress in an in vitro study on the model synovial cell line SW982.

pmc-12452981.title: Developing a Student-Centred Curriculum: Insights from Anaesthetic Placement Experiences for Co-Designing in China’s Greater Bay Area
pmc-12452981.creator: Chanyan Huang, Ying Xiao, Dan Xu, Io Nam Wong, Nivritti Gajanan Patil, Jiancong Chen, Kunsong Zhang, Wenjie Hu, Jianrong Zhang, Shuqin Ding, Ming Kuang, Haipeng Xiao, Xia Feng
pmc-12452981.description: IntroductionMedical education standards influence the academic performance and clinical competencies of medical students as career practitioners. With the rising demand for teaching innovation and technological advancement in medical education, clinical teaching in China has faced many challenges, which necessitate a re-evaluation of traditional educational approaches.

pmc-12682960.title: Superior vena cava syndrome requiring extra-anatomic bypass in a pediatric patient
pmc-12682960.creator: Uzma Rahman, Nkosi H. Alvarez, Ahmet Kilic
pmc-12682960.description: atrium distally. Central Message SVC syndrome is rare in the pediatric population and can become life-threatening. Extra-anatomic venous reconstruction can be offered to select patients when endovascular treatment is not feasible. Superior vena cava (SVC) syndrome encompasses a range of clinical signs and symptoms resulting from obstruction of venous blood flow through the SVC.

pmc-13381044.title: Long-Term Results of Busulfan Plus High-Dose Idarubicin as a Conditioning Regimen to Autologous Stem Cell Transplantation Following Cytarabine Consolidation in Young Patients with Favorable or Intermediate-Risk Acute Myeloid Leukemia
pmc-13381044.creator: Zixing Lu, Yayi Liu, Zhaoqing Jiang, Yu Zhu, Wenjie Liu, Qian Sun, Lei Fan, Sixuan Qian, Ming Hong
pmc-13381044.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the long-term efficacy and safety of high-dose idarubicin plus busulfan (I-Bu) conditioning followed by autologous stem cell transplantation (ASCT) compared to intermediate- to high-dose cytarabine (Ara-C) consolidation in young acute myeloid leukemia (AML) patients with favorable- or intermediate-risk in first complete remission (CR1).

pmc-13440482.title: Mito‐TEMPO Improves Post‐Thaw Quality and Fertilizing Capacity of Rooster Semen Cryopreserved in Beltsville Extender
pmc-13440482.creator: Mahdi Mokhtari, Mahdi Khodaei‐Motlagh, Reza Masoudi, Mohsen Sharafi
pmc-13440482.description: BackgroundRooster semen cryopreservation is a reproductive technology carried out to boost genetic gain and productivity in chicken's commercial flocks. However, semen cryopreservation significantly decreases the quality and fertilizing potential of sperm cells.ObjectivesThis study evaluated cryoprotective effects of the mitochondria‐targeted antioxidant Mito‐TEMPO added to the freezing medium by assessing post‐thaw characteristics of rooster sperm.

pmc-13589002.title: CEUS in the evaluation of focal salivary gland lesions: a systematic review
pmc-13589002.creator: Alessio Frisone, Giuseppe Balice, Matteo Serroni, Gianmaria D’Addazio, Antonella Berardicurti, Andrea Boccatonda

pmc-13632526.title: From predicted bacteriocins to ecological function
pmc-13632526.creator: Samson Baranzan Wayah, Kensuke Arakawa, Koshy Philip
pmc-13632526.description: Highlights•Predicted bacteriocin loci do not by themselves establish ecological function.•We distinguish transcriptional, conditional, phenotypic, and ecological silence.•Sequence data reveal encoded potential, but context determines realized function.•A function-first framework links loci to expression, targets, and outcomes.•Bacteriocins provide a model for interpreting hidden antimicrobial repertoires.
